name: gravity-on
$comment: Gravity ON: g0 = 9.81 in all five bodies. The body hangs 0.2 m below the pivot, starts tilted 0.5 rad about the world axis (1, 1, 0) and swings while the wheels are driven; d/dt of the total angular momentum about the pivot equals the gravity torque of the five centres of mass.
